title: Existence of a randomized hard language
statement: Assume that the class of languages decidable in polynomial time with bounded error equals the class of languages decidable in deterministic polynomial time. Then there is a language in the bounded-error probabilistic polynomial-time class to which every language in that class is polynomial-time many-one reducible.
hypotheses_covered: The bounded-error probabilistic polynomial-time class equals the deterministic polynomial-time class
